title: What is known about 1RB0RE_0LC1LE_0RD1LD_1RA1LF_1LC0RA_0LB---
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB0RE_0LC1LE_0RD1LD_1RA1LF_1LC0RA_0LB---.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state, two-symbol Turing machine halts when started on a blank tape: it is one of the holdouts left open by the bbchallenge project. This page lists what has been established about it, sorted by what each result rests on.
verdict: The question is open, and Collatz-like. The run is a sequence of phases Z → (3Z + c)/2 on a run of zeros (the sweeps are proved in Lean); Z mod 4 drives a counter in a short word D at the fixed left end. 1,500 phases from blank tape (far past 10350 steps) do not halt, With the residues chosen freely, words D on which a phase halts are reachable; the real orbit has not produced one.

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (F1); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>9</sup> steps
claims.text: The C simulator tools/c/triage.c runs 109 steps without a halt; at the end 34,606 cells have been visited and 2,752 of them hold a 1.

claims.title: The sweeps of a phase
claims.text: With 4j + 4 zeros left of 1 0 0 0 (100)^n 0 A> at the right end, j sweeps eat 4j zeros and add 2j words 100 to the wall (one sweep: 18n + 64 steps, any tape to the left).

claims.title: The phase map
claims.text: From PS(D, Z) = D 0^Z 1 0 0 E> the next phase start is PS(D', Z') with Z' = (3Z + c)/2, where D' and c depend only on D and Z mod 4: found by running the machine at three Z of the same residue and extrapolating, checked against the plain machine on the 16 phase starts from blank tape (to step 8.7·107).

claims.title: The counter in D
claims.text: For D(a, b) = 0 1 0^a 1 0 1 (001)^b: Z ≡ 1 leaves D alone, Z ≡ 3 makes it D(a−1, b+1), Z stays odd; at a = 0 a phase with Z ≡ 3 resets D to 0 1 0^(3b+5) 1, which continues as D(3b+4, 0) if Z ≡ 3 mod 8 and leaves the family otherwise. Checked for a, b < 16.

claims.title: No halt in 1,500 phases
claims.text: Iterating the phase map from the first phase start (assuming the linear extrapolation, checked as above): resets of the counter at phases 5, 29, 92, 332 stay in the family (cycles of length 11, 35, 107, 323); at phase 1001 (Z has 178 digits) the word leaves it and a second-level counter starts. No halt up to phase 1,500.

claims.title: Halting words exist
claims.text: With the residue Z mod 4 chosen freely at every phase, 23,305 words of at most 24 cells are reachable from the first phase start, and 7,145 of the (word, residue) pairs met halt, for example 0 1 0 0 1 1 1 0 1 with Z ≡ 3. So halting is not excluded by the words alone; it depends on the residues along the real orbit.

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: Not known. It reduces to the orbit of the map Z → (3Z + c)/2 and the nested counters it drives in D: whether the residues along the orbit ever build a halting word.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows. This machine runs a cousin of the Collatz map. Each phase it turns a run of Z zeros into a wall of 100 words and back into about 3Z/2 zeros. The remainder of Z mod 4 ticks a counter kept in a short word at the far end of the tape, and the counter runs through cycles that grow threefold.

facts.text: What one sweep eats and builds; chained over a whole phase in Lean.
The phase map on the run of zeros, with a constant set by Z mod 4.
No halt from blank tape, far past 10<sup>350</sup> steps.

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.525).
After 109 steps the tape spans 34,606 cells (10 left of the start, 26,759 right), with a density of 1s of 0.08.
These are measurements of one bounded run, sorted by tools/py/bbtools/triage.py; the macro structure behind them is the next thing to find.

sections.heading: A phase: zeros to wall and back
html: A phase starts with the tape D 0^Z 1 0 0: a short word D at the fixed left end, a run of Z zeros, and the head in state E at the right end. Each sweep the head runs left across a growing wall of 100 words, eats four zeros at the edge of the run, and comes back with two more words on the wall. After about Z/4 sweeps the zeros are used up. The head then works on D, and the wall, now about 3Z/2 cells long, becomes the next run of zeros.
So Z' = (3Z + c)/2, with a small c that depends on D and on Z mod 4. A phase costs about 9Z2/8 steps.

sections.heading: A counter in the word D
html: Write D(a, b) = 0 1 0^a 1 0 1 (001)^b. A phase with Z ≡ 1 mod 4 leaves D alone. A phase with Z ≡ 3 moves one unit from a to b. Z stays odd throughout. When a reaches 0, the next phase with Z ≡ 3 resets the word to 0 1 0^(3b+5) 1, and a new cycle three times as long begins: 11, 35, 107, 323, 971 units.

That holds only if Z ≡ 3 mod 8 at the reset. Otherwise the word grows a second level, a counter that moves by four and two units per phase. From blank tape the first four resets went the simple way. The fifth, at phase 1001, did not.

sections.heading: An open, Collatz-like question
html: Halting depends on the orbit of Z under a 3/2 map whose constant depends on Z mod 4, together with the nested counters it drives. Words D on which a phase halts do exist. Choosing the residues freely reaches them, but the real orbit has not produced one so far.

summary: A run of Z zeros is turned into a wall of 100 words and back each phase, Z -> about 3Z/2; Z mod 4 drives a counter in a short word at the fixed end, whose cycles grow threefold, and Z mod 8 at the end of a cycle decides whether the word grows a new level. Halting words are reachable with freely chosen residues, not so far along the real orbit.
